steps.action: Change the Status through Review, Approval, Signature and Active; read the Stage beside each Status; check the pill and History
steps.expected: The menu lists each Status with its Stage; each move shows the new Status beside the C- reference and the Stage display, and History records it.
steps.actual: Menu items: ["Draft Draft","Internal review Review","With counterparty Review","Awaiting approval Approval","Out for signature Signature","Active Active","Expired Ended","Terminated Ended","Signed, awaiting countersignature Signature","Superseded Ended","DOC-030 compat contracts-a review 1790331153427 Review"]. Moves: Internal review -> Review; Awaiting approval -> Approval; Out for signature -> Signature; Active -> Active; each time the header showed the Status beside C-59 and "<Stage> — move contract". Moving to Signature created 0 Envelopes and Active added 0 Documents. History: "Nadia Haddad changed the status Out for signature → Active this minute Nadia Haddad changed the status Awaiting approval → Out for signature this minute Nadia Haddad changed the status Internal review → Awaiting approval this minute Nadia Haddad changed the status Draft → Internal review this minute Nadia Haddad added Jonas Weber to the team this minute Nadia Haddad created this contract this minu".

steps.expected: A move back to Review and a skip from Review to Active are both accepted.
steps.actual: Active -> Internal review accepted, then Internal review -> Active (skipping Approval and Signature) accepted; now Active (active).

steps.action: Negative: renaming a Status does not change its Stage
steps.expected: After the Administrator renames the fixture Status, the menu shows the new name with the same Review Stage and the Contract in that Status keeps Stage review.
steps.actual: Moved to the fixture Status; Daniel Okafor renamed it to "DOC-030 compat contracts-a renamed by legal_team_member 1790331153427" (a rename carrying a Stage answered 400). The Contract reads DOC-030 compat contracts-a renamed by legal_team_member 1790331153427 / review; the menu item reads "DOC-030 compat contracts-a renamed by legal_team_member 1790331153427 Review".

steps.action: Soft gate: Move past approval lists unresolved approvals; Cancel keeps the Status; Move anyway records the override
steps.expected: Cancel keeps the current Status; Move anyway saves and History records the override; the approval is still pending.
steps.actual: Dialog: "Move past approval 1 approval on this contract is unresolved. Moving to Out for signature goes past sign-off. DO Daniel Okafor Pending This is allowed. It is recorded on the record's activity as an override. Cancel Move anyway". Cancel kept Awaiting approval. Move anyway saved Out for signature. History: "Nadia Haddad moved this contract past approval, overriding Daniel Okafor this minute Nadia Haddad changed the status Awaiting approval → Out for signature this minute Nadia Haddad asked Daniel Okafor". The approval for Daniel Okafor is still pending.

steps.expected: After moving to an Ended Status the record still accepts edits.
steps.actual: Moved to Expired (Ended); Priority Critical saved on the Ended Contract.

steps.action: Negative: archived records and Business Users get no Status control; Restore brings it back
steps.expected: Archived: no Stage move control and a direct write is refused. Jonas in the Portal has no control and cannot change the Status. After Restore the control works.
steps.actual: Jonas Weber (team member, Portal) saw 0 Status controls and a direct Status write answered 403. Archived C-59 showed 0 Stage move controls and a direct write answered 409. After Restore (200) the Stage control moved it to Active.
